script_text: Stop! Taurus, cosmic energies are jolting your senses right now. Jupiter in Gemini forms a harmonious sextile to your ruling planet Venus, energizing your 3rd House of Communication, while Saturn in Pisces casts a stabilizing trine to your 11th House of Social Networks. This blend sharpens your ideas and expands your circle. In love, single Taureans should attract partners through intellectual curiosity, while those attached might navigate a quiet tension that reveals deeper needs. Financially, the 6th House of daily work rewards meticulous planning and steady effort, so avoid impulsive spending. Beware of overcommitting your time to others' demands, which can drain your precious resources. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate these shifts with grace.
